{"id":1941338258,"question_id":4240,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1772937846,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1941338258/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find the Smallest Balanced Index","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    int smallestBalancedIndex(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n\n        vector<ll>suff(n , 1);\n        for(int i = n-2 ; i>=0 ; i--)\n        {\n            suff[i] = suff[i+1] * nums[i+1];\n        }\n\n        ll ls = 0;\n        for(int i=0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            ll right = suff[i];\n            if(ls == right) return i;\n            ls += nums[i];\n        }\n    return -1;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-the-smallest-balanced-index","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1804}
